payload.name: Verification Lives Outside Production Code
payload.description: Dry runs, probes and end-to-end drivers are scripts outside the product code that call the real routes. Production source carries behavior and its focused unit tests.

principles.name: Production code is deployment code
principles.description: A product build should not carry drivers whose only job is to test it.

heuristics.condition: a code path named dry_run, demo or probe is found in production source
heuristics.action: decide whether it moves to a script or is real behavior, and record the decision

decision_rules.name: Put drivers in scripts
decision_rules.condition: a dry run, probe, seeding step or end-to-end driver is needed
decision_rules.outcome: write it as a script under tools that calls the real route and writes evidence, not as a mode inside the product

decision_rules.name: Keep product tests focused
decision_rules.condition: a test is added to product source
decision_rules.outcome: keep it a unit test of real logic under cfg(test), not a harness that stands in for a real run

decision_rules.name: Defaults are production
decision_rules.condition: a switch or code path exists only to support testing
decision_rules.outcome: remove it or move it to the script, so the shipped default is the production behavior
